cases.name: symbol-filter-expression
cases.prompt: I have the godig CLI installed. Give me the exact single command to list only the exported top-level functions (not methods, types, vars or consts) in github.com/samber/lo whose names start with "Filter", rendered for pasting into chat.
cases.trap: Without the skill a model guesses a regex, a grep pipeline, lowercase kind values like func, or a nonexistent --kind flag.
expectations: Uses `--filter` with a Go boolean expression combining `kind=="Function"` and `hasPrefix(name,"Filter")` via `&&`
Wraps the filter expression in single quotes
negative_expectations: Uses lowercase or abbreviated kind values such as "func" or "function"
Pipes output through grep instead of filtering server-side

cases.name: major-versions-lookup
cases.prompt: With godig available, how do I check whether github.com/samber/lo has a v2 (or later) major version, and which command lists the versions inside that newer major once I know its path?
cases.trap: Without the skill a model runs `versions github.com/samber/lo` and expects v2 tags there, not realising majors >= 2 are separate modules.
expectations: Explains that v2+ lives under a separate module path suffixed with /vN
Uses `godig versions <module>/vN` for the newer major
negative_expectations: Claims `godig versions github.com/samber/lo` lists v2+ tags

cases.name: search-filter-field-name
cases.prompt: Using godig, search Go packages for "retry backoff" but keep only results whose package path lives under github.com/cenkalti/. Give the command, with the output rendered for pasting into chat.
cases.trap: Natural guess is a `path` field, which search rejects with `undefined identifier: path`.
negative_expectations: Uses `path` as the filter identifier for search
Filters client-side with grep or jq instead of --filter

cases.name: single-symbol-pinned-version
cases.prompt: Our go.mod pins github.com/samber/lo v1.50.0. I only need the signature and doc of lo.Map at exactly that version, and I want to keep token use low. Which one godig command should you run? I'll paste the output into chat, so render it accordingly.
cases.trap: A model without the skill fetches `package doc` (very large) or omits the version, returning latest-version docs, or uses an invalid path@version syntax.
negative_expectations: Uses `package doc` or `package examples` for this single-symbol need
